model_contract.equilibrium_baseline: Two formation yields; equilibrium Morakul/Mouret transfer; nominal capture efficiency fixed at 0.85/0.88.
model_contract.fitted_capture_efficiency: Same biological production and equilibrium loss, with one compound-specific constant fraction mapping emitted aroma mass to recovered condensate mass.

validation_policy.selection_rule: simplest model passing all species/domain guardrails; otherwise no validated model

data_quality_policy.reason: Common six-analyte spike at 144 h; raw chromatogram and independent duplicate unavailable. Retained because paired condensate also peaks and similar common spikes occur elsewhere.

interpretation_limits.capture_efficiency: This is an effective observation fraction from emitted aroma to recovered condensate. Without direct outlet-gas and trap-recovery measurements it cannot be assigned uniquely to condenser thermodynamics.
interpretation_limits.post_hoc_status: Introduced after the nested timing models failed and after auditing the 230 L reactor-volume scaling. It is exploratory and requires prospective confirmation.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: All six runs have informed model development; leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation, not prospective confirmation.
